build.buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const keys=['GOOGLE_CLIENT_EMAIL','GOOGLE_PRIVATE_KEY_B64','TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID','TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN'];let content='';keys.forEach(k=>{if(process.env[k])content+=k+'='+JSON.stringify(process.env[k])+'\n'});if(content){fs.writeFileSync('.env',content);console.log('Build: wrote',keys.filter(k=>process.env[k]).length,'vars to .env');}else{console.log('Build: no user vars found at build time');}" && npm run build
